name: Student visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being 16 or over. Under-18 applicants at independent schools should look at the Child Student visa instead.
This requires a place on a course from a UK institution holding a valid student sponsor licence, confirmed via a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) reference.
requirements.fix_path: Secure an offer from a licensed sponsor institution and obtain a CAS.

value.note: course fees (per CAS) plus £1,529/month (London) or £1,171/month (outside London), up to 9 months — waived if applicant has held a valid UK visa for 12+ months at time of application

requirements.blocker_text: This requires enough money held for 28 consecutive days to cover outstanding course fees plus maintenance at £1,529/month (London) or £1,171/month (outside London), for up to 9 months — unless exempt.
requirements.fix_path: Hold the required funds continuously for 28 days before applying, or wait until you qualify for the 12-month UK residence exemption.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires the ability to speak, read, write and understand English at the level required for your specific course — evidenced via an approved test, unless exempt (e.g. degree taught in English, majority English-speaking nationality).
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved Secure English Language Test at the level required for your course.

requirements.blocker_text: If you're 16 or 17, this requires evidence of parental consent.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain and provide written parental consent.

evidence_required.document: CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) reference from sponsor institution
Bank statements showing required funds held for 28 consecutive days (unless exempt)
Tuberculosis test certificate (if from a listed country)
ATAS certificate (if doing a postgraduate research course in certain sensitive science/engineering subjects)

outcome.duration_length: up to 5 years (degree-level course), up to 2 years (below degree level)

sources.title: Student visa: Money you need - GOV.UK
Student visa: Knowledge of English - GOV.UK

notes: Fee confirmed at £558 via direct fetch of gov.uk (page itself shows updated_at 2026-08-07, i.e. today) — this is current, post the 8 April 2026 fee rise. Multiple 2026-dated secondary sources still show the pre-rise £490 figure; another counterfeit-figure case, same pattern as UK Skilled Worker's £38,700 vs £41,700. family_can_join is false as a blanket default here — this is a simplification flagged honestly: PhD/doctoral-research students and government-sponsored students on approved programmes CAN bring a partner and children, standard taught Masters/undergrad students cannot. The schema's boolean family_can_join can't express this conditional split cleanly; a fuller pass would need a RequirementGroup split (research vs. taught) rather than one flat answer, similar to the known Outcome-bound-to-Route gap seen on uk_global_talent and uk_ilr. Left as a single group for now rather than over-engineering before it's needed elsewhere.
